description:
Where Bitcoin is against its power-law trend right now: live price, trend (fair) value, % deviation,
    zone, lower and upper band, the fit used, the next halving, and three checks of whether the model still
    holds (the falsification conditions of Santostasi & Perrenod 2026: a floor 3 sigma under the trend held for a
    year, the exponent leaving [5, 7], and address-count growth), each "ok", "watch" or "broken".
name: get_power_law_status
title: Bitcoin vs the power law today
